title: BPW-2026-0512
text:
[JOINT REPORT]
BPW-2026-0512
BOE + BCA
CD 3, 4, 6
CONTRACT AWARD – ENVIRONMENTAL CONSTRUCTION, INC. (ECI)
Recommending the Board:
DECLARE Griffith Company, the first low bidder, to be non-responsive, as discussed in this report;
RECEIVE and FILE Transmittal No. 4;
FIND Transmittal No. 5 to be unmerited, as discussed in this report;
DECLARE ECI, second low bidder, to be the lowest responsive, responsible bidder, and award ECI a contract for the Los Angeles Riverway West San Fernando Valley Completion Project Vanalden Avenue to Balboa Boulevard (Re-Bid) project for the Total Bid Amount of $83,992,694, as discussed in this report; and
AUTHORIZE the President or two members of the Board to execute the contract after approval as to form has been obtained from the City Attorney.
(W.O.: E190752B)
